newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end flat in thin, lacklustre trade.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end flat in thin, lacklustre trade.

text.p: Madrid stock indices ended slightly lower on Monday, with selected stocks seeing some interest in otherwise dull trade, dealers said.
The general index fell 0.52 points, 0.14 percent, to 384.24 and the Ibex-35 fell 6.72 points, 0.15 percent, to 4,421.36.
Telefonica held early gains after a date for the liberatisation of Spanish telecoms in December 1998 was confirmed. The stock added 25 pesetas to 2,680.
Building firm Cubiertas added 1.9 percent to 9,650 following news last week of its merger with Entrecanales.
Gas Natural fell 140 pesetas to 23,200 after the government announced on Friday an institutional placement of its 3.8 percent stake in the firm, and ahead of results tomorrow.

In general volume was thin, dominated by trading as most awaited October inflation data due later this week and a raft of nine-month corporate results, kicking off with Repsol and Gas Natural on Tuesday.
Underlying support for the market is strong, dealers said, but traders are awaiting new factors to fuel further gains.
